backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko backend actor with no methods or state defined.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three UI update features (MainCard message, CelebrationScreen messaging, RunawayButton quips) to their affected files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing the purpose and current state of each frontend source file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS entry point that imports Tailwind layers and defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including colors, borders, and chart tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell with the page title 'Come Back Saachi' and a root div that mounts the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component rendering a Slytherin-themed page with a floating particles background, a MainCard asking Saachi for a second date, and a CelebrationScreen shown after clicking Yes.
frontend/src/components/CelebrationScree: Celebration screen displayed after the user clicks Yes, featuring Slytherin-colored confetti, floating magical emoji particles, and joyful messaging about a second date with Saachi.
frontend/src/components/FloatingHearts.t: Background decoration component that renders 22 randomly positioned Harry Potter-themed emoji particles floating upward with varied speeds and opacities.
frontend/src/components/RunawayButton.ts: A 'No' button that runs away on hover or touch, displaying 20 playful Harry Potter-themed quips consistent with a one-date scenario.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on the ICP blockchain, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file defining a Slytherin/Harry Potter dark magical theme with emerald and silver OKLCH color tokens, Cinzel/Crimson Text fonts, Tailwind layers, and keyframe animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that mounts the root component wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with Slytherin-themed color tokens, custom fonts, border radii, box shadows, and accordion animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing a Harry Potter/Slytherin-themed webpage asking a girl named Saachi to come back, featuring a heartfelt message, a runaway 'No' button with witty quips, and a celebratory 'Yes' response screen.
